details.label: Alert detail
details.text:
The Flood Watch will expire for portions of east central Ohio,
including the following areas, Belmont, Guernsey, Jefferson OH,
Monroe and Noble, Pennsylvania, including the following areas,
Beaver, Fayette, Greene, Higher Elevations of Fayette, Lawrence and
Mercer, and West Virginia, including the following areas, Brooke,
Eastern Preston, Eastern Tucker, Hancock, Marion, Marshall,
Monongalia, Ohio, Preston, Ridges of Eastern Monongalia and
Northwestern Preston, Western Tucker and Wetzel.

The flash flooding threat has ended. Therefore, the Flood Watch will
expire at 1 AM EDT early this morning.
